correctness.rationale: The channel is defined on full binary Hamming-one outputs. Constant weight makes radius-one-ball disjointness equivalent to pairwise distance at least four. Exact rational primal and dual assignments, independently checked against every input/output constraint at each semilength one through six, establish all fractional optima; integer codes match the first five. At semilength six a complete GNU C++17 clique search using mathematically sound greedy-color upper pruning proves 22 optimal, and the explicit 22-word witness is independently verified; SciPy MILP corroborates but is not proof.

value.rationale: Dyck source words are a canonical constrained balanced source and the bases of the Catalan matroid; Hamming single-error correction and its fractional shadow relaxation are natural fundamental objects. Identifying the first strict gap after five exact small instances (22 versus 26) isolates a meaningful failure of linear-relaxation sharpness, with reproducible primal/dual certificates and exhaustive integer obstruction. The finite classification is useful without a downstream asymptotic theorem.
